artworks.title: Am Walchensee (On Walchen Lake)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective, looking over a body of water. The horizon is located in the upper third of the composition, with a range of mountains or hills stretching across the image. The foreground includes sketchy lines representing rooftops and vegetation on the left side. The middle ground features a water expanse depicted with horizontal strokes suggesting gentle waves or ripples. In the background, there are mountains sketched with dynamic lines forming jagged peaks against the sky. Soft, swirling lines indicate clouds above, adding movement to the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and gray. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, giving the artwork a casual, sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Der Neue See (The New Lake)
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image depicts a woodland scene from a slightly elevated angle. Various tree trunks with branches and foliage are visible on the left side, casting horizontal lines across the scene. The lines are quick and energetic, giving a sense of movement and depth. The color palette is limited to shades of black and beige, creating a strong contrast between the dark forms and the lighter background.

artworks.title: Versöhnung (The Reconciliation)
artworks.medium: drypoint in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals, focusing on their upper bodies. One person is slightly reclined with their head resting in the hands of the other person who is seated. The reclining person has long hair and facial features highlighted by a shadow, while the seated person has short, wavy hair and is looking downwards. The seated person appears to wear a sleeveless garment with wide shoulders. The sketch has a minimalistic style with a plain background. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image.

artworks.title: Kavaliere mit einer frau (Cavaliers with a Woman)
artworks.medium: etching in black on Van Gelder Zonen laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Toni G. Marcy
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract group of figures. The drawing consists of loosely sketched figures that appear to be interacting in a dynamic manner, with strong, expressive lines that convey motion and emotion. The use of shading and cross-hatching creates a sense of depth, while the rough and rugged lines give the drawing an energetic and spontaneous feel. The composition is somewhat chaotic, with overlapping forms and lines suggesting movement and engagement among the figures, contributing to an impression of expressive tension and drama.

artworks.title: Boy with Cat (Knabe mit Katze)
artworks.medium: lithograph on yellow wove paper
artworks.description: The image features an abstract representation of a person in a leaning position, with their upper body partially shown. The person's facial features are depicted with strong lines and shadows, suggesting a contemplative expression. They have dark hair tied back and are holding a patterned textile with bold geometric shapes. A cat shape is next to them. The background consists of abstract textures and lines, creating depth. The composition is monochromatic with contrasting light and dark areas.

artworks.title: Saint Mark
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure surrounded by cherubic forms on clouds. The central figure is depicted with a flowing beard and robes, resting their arm and holding a scroll or piece of paper above the clouds. Around this figure, there are smaller figures resembling cherubs, each with curly hair and distinct expressions, engaged in various actions such as holding sheets or gesturing towards the central figure. The background suggests a sky filled with swirling clouds. The linework is detailed, emphasizing the contours and textures of the robes, clouds, and hair, offering a sense of movement and depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Saint Luke
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure with four cherubic figures surrounding them. The main person is seated with their right elbow on their knee and hand supporting their chin. They have curly hair and prominent facial features. The figure wears a flowing robe and is seated on a cloudy surface. The cherubs have curly hair and small wings, some holding a large scroll or tablet. They have plump faces. The background features clouds. The composition is in a sketch-like, monochromatic style emphasizing line work.

artworks.title: Veduta del Prospetto della Chiesa di S. Giorgio Maggiore
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of an architectural scene featuring the church of San Giorgio Maggiore. The horizon aligns with the base of the church, which is the central focus. The facade is surrounded by buildings and a bell tower. The engraving uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of grey. In the foreground, there are small boats and gondolas on the water with people.

artworks.title: Der Landschaftmaler auf der Reise (The Landscape Painter on Tour)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a rocky outcrop, sketching the landscape ahead of him. The background features hills, a river, a boat with figures, buildings, trees, and a church spire. The man appears absorbed in his drawing. The artwork is detailed and monochromatic.

artworks.title: Panorama of Tivoli from a Loggia
artworks.medium: graphite with brown and blue washes on light green wove paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from inside an archway looking out towards a distant landscape. Two large arches frame the view, creating depth. The horizon is low with a faint mountain range sketched on it. Closer structures include a tower and rooftops. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes and a washed effect, giving it an ethereal look. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and hints of beige. Objects like a curtain, a bowl, and a plant are sketched close by, adding dimension. In the distance, architectural structures like houses with visible rooftops extend towards the horizon under a minimal sky.

artworks.title: Fortified Castle on a High Cliff
artworks.medium: pen and red ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a castle on a cliff. The castle is viewed from a lower angle, showcasing its towers and stonework. The horizon is not visible, and the castle dominates the upper part of the composition. The drawing features intricate linework using reddish-brown ink. Trees are depicted near the viewer, and the foliage is detailed with textured lines, creating depth as they descend the slope. The color palette is limited, highlighting the ink against the background. The castle in the distance is intricately sketched, suggesting grandeur and history.

artworks.title: Return of the Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, one standing and one kneeling. The standing figure is on the left, looking down at the kneeling figure on the right. The standing person has a long beard and wears a robe with long sleeves. The kneeling figure has long, wavy hair, and holds a shepherd's crook. Both figures wear simple garments. The setting is outdoors with rocky terrain, a large rock in the foreground, and a small tree or shrub in the middle ground. The sky is lightly sketched.

artworks.title: Fantasy Panorama of Rome from St. Peter's to the Castel San Angelo
artworks.medium: graphite on 2 joined sheets of wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows a panoramic view of a landscape. In the left part, there is a dome structure near the horizon. To the right, there is a stone wall with buildings and trees beyond it. The trees frame the scene on the right. The horizon line is indicated in the middle, with buildings becoming less defined towards the background. The pencil lines are delicate but confident, showing shading and detail to create depth and precision. The lack of color highlights the monochromatic palette, enhancing the play of line and shadow in the composition.

artworks.title: The Miraculous Draught of Fishes
artworks.artist: Schelte Adams Bolswert after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on 3 sheets of laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fishermen pulling in a large net filled with fish from the sea with two boats in the water. The scene shows individuals exerting effort as they pull the net towards the shore. Seagulls are flying above, and the sea has gentle waves. The sky is partially cloudy with light on the horizon. Various sea creatures are visible on the shore, including a crab and a starfish. The image conveys hard work and a bountiful yield from the sea.

artworks.title: Don Pietro dei Medici
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man's upper body. He is slightly facing left while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a well-groomed beard and mustache, with his hair neatly brushed back. He is dressed in a high-collared ruffled garment typical of his era, featuring intricate vertical patterns. In his right hand, he holds a sword with the hilt visible. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame decorated with ribbon-like details, with Latin text inscribed below the image.

artworks.title: Garzia dei Medici
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a young boy shown from the chest upwards. He is facing forward within an ornate oval frame, with an expressionless face. The boy has short, curly hair and distinct facial features with a rounded face. He is dressed in a richly detailed garment with intricate embroidery, featuring a high collar adorned with lace. The fabric around his neck and shoulders appears textured with vertical patterns. The portrait is encased in an elaborate frame with ribbons at the bottom, inscribed with text. In the background, engraved patterns and designs enhance the formal and historical look of the image.

artworks.title: Ferdinando II, Grand Duke of Tuscany
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man in a three-quarter position, facing slightly to his right. The man has long, wavy hair that falls down to his shoulders. His facial features include a pronounced mustache and a calm expression. He wears a long, elegant robe with voluminous folds over armor. In his hand, he holds a baton or staff. The background features an ornate oval frame with intricate detailing and the area around the portrait includes decorative elements and scrolls with Latin text.

artworks.title: Cardinal Giovanni Carlo dei Medici
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The engraving features an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to his left. He has a calm expression, a moustache, long curly hair, and wears a high-collared garment with a biretta on his head. His left hand is raised, holding a small rolled-up object. The background includes an oval frame with intricate decorations, a draped banner, an escutcheon with a coat of arms, and an inscription for identification.

artworks.title: Cosimo III, Grand Duke of Tuscany
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is seated with a slightly turned position, looking directly at the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair, distinct facial features including a prominent nose and full lips, and wears intricate armor embellished with a high lace collar. He holds a narrow baton or staff. The portrait is set within an oval frame with elaborate carvings and an inscription identifying him as "Cosimus Tertius." The background is a textured surface.

artworks.title: Cardinal Francesco Maria dei Medici
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a young person in an oval frame. The individual has a round face, curly hair extending to the shoulders, and is wearing a garment with a star insignia and a wide collared shirt. The frame surrounding the portrait is ornate, with ribbons and detailed carvings. An inscription mentions "Franciscus Maria" and Ferdinand II. The background outside the oval frame is intricately detailed.

artworks.title: The Doge Carried around the Piazza San Marco
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated viewpoint looking down on a bustling scene. The horizon line runs through the base of a tall tower in the center-right. The architecture features buildings with arches and columns on both sides. The focus is on a grand structure in the distance. The artwork uses fine linework and detailed etching, indicative of a printmaking technique capturing architectural details and crowd activity. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black. A large crowd fills the space, surrounded by ornate buildings and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Doge Crowned on the Scala dei Giganti of the Ducal Palace
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The image depicts a detailed façade of a multi-storey building with many windows, columns, and decorative motifs. In the center, there is a staircase with statues leading up to a balcony where figures can be seen. In the courtyard below, figures are gathered around the stairs. The line work emphasizes the texture and ornamentation of the architecture. The composition directs the viewer's eye from the figures below up to the building's exterior.

artworks.title: The Doge Returns Thanks in the Sala del Consiglio Maggior
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand interior hall with ornate architectural elements and numerous figures in formal attire. The scene captures a vast, elaborately decorated room with a richly detailed ceiling featuring intricate moldings and classical motifs. On either side of the hall, large paintings or murals adorn the walls, depicting various scenes within framed panels. The ceiling's grandeur is matched by the tall arched windows, which line one of the walls, allowing light to spill into the room. The floor is populated by numerous figures, suggesting a formal assembly or gathering, all facing towards a focal point at the front of the hall. The setting suggests an opulent and ceremonial environment, with attendees organized in rows and some standing closer to the center.

artworks.title: The Doge in the Bucintoro Departing for the Porto di Lido on Ascension Day
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with people watching a maritime event. In the background, there is a large decorated ship on the water, surrounded by other boats. The city of Venice is visible in the distance, with its distinct architecture including domes and towers. The artwork is detailed and in a grayscale color palette, giving a classic and historical feel to the scene.
